_comment: EGM Downloader Mac update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmac-update.json
_version_notes: Fixed: Error messages at start up no longer open behind the splash screen.
Security: The Python that comes with the app no longer reads your own Python packages or settings, so a stray file or setting there cannot change it or run code in it.
Privacy: Spellcheck is off and the app no longer downloads a spellcheck dictionary. Deno and pip no longer look for their own updates, and What's New reads only the notes that come with the app.

Privacy: The app no longer tells image servers which app is asking: no app name or Electron in the user agent, only the Chrome version number a browser sends, no referrer, and no early lookups of the links on screen.
Privacy: History pictures are now fetched the way a browser would, with no cookies and no referrer, and only over HTTPS.
Privacy: The app's own update checks and its ffmpeg and Deno downloads now identify themselves only as EGM-Downloader.

Privacy: Clear History now also removes the debug and error logs, empties the Console and deletes leftover request files. Import History and the 500 entry limit also delete the pictures of entries that leave the list.
Privacy: yt-dlp's challenge solver now comes with the app, and Update Plugins keeps it matched to yt-dlp, so it is normally not downloaded while you use the app.
Fixed: Check for Updates now offers yt-dlp again when the solver package does not match it, and Update Plugins reports it if the solver could not be updated.

Changed: The app now ignores your own yt-dlp configuration file, so options set there, like a proxy, no longer change what the app does. It also ignores your pip settings, except when it installs the yt-dlp nightly.
New: The app now includes THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, with the licenses of the libraries it bundles.
Electron runtime updated to v45.3.2. It no longer trusts certificates issued by eMudhra's revoked RSA intermediates.

Fixed: Random theme on launch no longer picks a seasonal theme outside its dates.
Fixed: The message when ffmpeg could not be downloaded now names the buttons that exist, in every language.
Fixed: 7 themes (Dark World, Mermaid, Woodgrain, Odd Cab, Havana, Hangang and Seoul) have clearer accents, error colors and quiet text. Hangang is now cyan instead of pink.
Fixed: The color dots in the theme lists now match the real colors of every theme.
Security: Thumbnail file names in History are checked the same strict way everywhere.
Electron runtime updated to v45.2.3.
Security: The Python that comes with the app is now 3.11.18, a security release.
The app may start faster.
Fixed: Quitting while Subscriptions downloads are running now asks first, and Keep open really keeps the app and its downloads running.
Fixed: If the app crashes or is force quit, its downloads now stop too, and the next start opens normally instead of being blocked by a leftover copy.
Fixed: Force refresh in Subscriptions keeps the videos you already downloaded marked as downloaded.

Fixed: If ffmpeg could not be set up on first start, for example when you were offline, a download now says so right away and what to do, in every language, instead of waiting and then saying it is still being set up.
Fixed: Installing or updating ffmpeg can no longer leave a broken copy behind, and a plugins update or Deno install that fails now says so instead of reporting Update complete.

Fixed: A download that fails before it starts now shows an error instead of waiting forever. Cancel also stops the conversion step after a download, and a failed H.264 conversion keeps the original download.
Fixed: A video with a long title in Japanese, Chinese or emoji is now saved under its title instead of its job number.
Fixed: Live recordings that cannot be joined keep every piece under its own name, even with a very long title, instead of waiting forever at the end.

Fixed: A damaged history, settings or subscriptions file no longer breaks the app, and saving a setting right after start can no longer erase your other settings. A copy of a damaged file is kept next to it as a .unreadable file; Clear history and Reset settings remove it.

Security: Imported history and settings are checked before they are saved, imported text is always shown as plain text, and the app only connects to its own background process, never to another program or a leftover copy. If another program uses the port, the app now says so.
Electron runtime updated to v45.2.2.
New: Drag the small handle at the top of the links card or the Settings panel to swap their places. The app remembers your choice, and it is included in Export and Import.
Fixed: Small labels, like Format, Video quality, the table headers and the Themes window headings, are clearer and easier to read on many themes.
Fixed: The hint text in the download folder field now follows your theme.
Fixed: The History, Console and Subscriptions pages now match the main window's colors on the default theme.
Fixed: The LIVE tag on a video card is readable on every theme.
Fixed: The format badges in History (MP3, MP4, FLAC and the like) are easier to read on light themes.
Fixed: The Save button in the Theme Creator panel is easier to read.
Fixed: Green buttons, like Stop and save, are easier to read on many themes.

Fixed: 139 themes are easier to read, with clearer labels, hints, status colors and button text. Some accents, surfaces and background patterns also changed, so similar themes look different from each other and text stays clear.
Electron runtime updated to v45.2.1.
Fixed: What's New now shows the notes of the version you are running, not the notes of the latest release. It also works without a connection.
Fixed: When a live recording ends on its own, the card now stays on Converting until it is saved, instead of going back to Recording for a moment.
Electron runtime updated to v45.1.0, with an updated Chromium (156.0.8078.49) and Node.js 24.22.1, a security release.
